repair_tags.observation: The Agent resolved the 151 initial missing-import diagnostics by installing the editable checkout with all runtime, test, optional, and documentation extras. This succeeded on the first complete installation attempt but is not established as a minimal path.
Editable installation compiled the ARM64 deforest, compiler-version, and spherical-overlap extensions. The Agent directly imported the local package and compiled modules before submission.

The operationally equivalent complete program reached zero missing imports in the voluntary fresh environment, but its combined diagnostic command exited 128 because a trailing git status encountered dubious repository ownership after the deployment goal had passed.

After configuring safe.directory, the voluntary fresh provider reported widespread executable-bit changes. The Agent verified zero textual numstat changes, and independent qualification audited zero tracked changes.

Editable installation generated ignored C sources, shared objects, package metadata, and reproject/version.py. Qualification accepted these as provenance-backed build outputs and found no disallowed untracked paths.
Official Pyright recorded 275 non-missing-import errors and three warnings across 49 files. These source diagnostics are descriptive and do not determine the benchmark objective.

scientific_interpretation.reason: The unrestricted Agent found an immediately viable all-extras installation, compiled the repository's native extensions, voluntarily confirmed an operationally equivalent program in a clean environment, and submitted a program that passed independent qualification and Official. The control therefore solved this case without an automatic replay treatment.
scientific_interpretation.measurement_implication: The case reinforces that terminal success and path quality are separate axes. Broad optional dependency closure can maximize compatibility but remains a candidate for later time, bandwidth, and disk minimization.
scientific_interpretation.live_frontier_implication: No promotion evidence; same-session free exploration plus complete-state replay achieved terminal success.
